In Journey of the Prairie King, the tombstone power-up displays the symbol of Yoba upside-down. Using it will cast lightning upon the player, turning them into an invulnerable zombie for a limited amount of time.

forbidden_errors: claims the symbol appears right-side up
claims the effect is permanent rather than limited time
claims a different effect than turning into a zombie
